podcast.title: Debut Record Produced by Patrick Carney
podcast.body: Patrick Carney contributed to the production of The Sheepdogs' debut record in 2012, highlighting his involvement in supporting other musical acts. "He produced part of the Sheep Dogs, 2012 debut record".

xref.title: Patrick Carney's Side Projects and Production
xref.body: Patrick Carney operates his own indie label, Audio Eagle Records, which signed the band Drummer. He also joined Drummer in the studio, playing bass, despite the band's members all being drummers from other groups. Carney's production work includes contributing to The Sheepdogs' 2012 debut record, as well as albums for Tennis and Tobias Gesso Jr. "Patrick Carney was watching an indie band called Drummer, who was signed to his audio-eagle records."
